scope: The individual home buyer of residential land: ordinarily resident (s 5) and foreign person limb (a) and temporary resident (s 4); residential land, new and established dwelling (s 4, reg 19); interest in Australian land (s 12); threshold test (s 52(1), reg 52(1)-(2)); notifiable action and compulsory notice (ss 47, 49, 81); the wait after notice (ss 77(8), 82); the home buyer exemptions (regs 28, 35(1)(a), 38(2), 38(3)); established dwellings (s 95); penalties (ss 84, 94, 95(7)). Out: entities, businesses, agricultural and commercial land, national security, certificates' own tests, orders, fees, vacancy fees, the Register.
